For clothing, the important points of evaluation are accuracy in sizing, quality of materials, the feel of the fabric on your skin, wash-ability, closet-space and fold-ability. As such, for dresses, these are the points I evaluate. I can't evaluate style, as we all have different tastes, but the objective points can be easily reported in review, to aid you in your search for that special something that will work for you and make you feel beautiful.

Accuracy In Sizing: This dress is sized nearly accurately, however, it runs slightly large, overall. The bust is larger, the arm-holes, the waist, and so on. It is just a slightly larger dress than described in the measurements.

Quality Of Materials: The material on this dress is quite nice. The slip is of a medium-weight and the lace is a high-quality, soft, draping lace. The stitching is average. Even more, it is made well enough that you could add sleeves, if you so desired.

Feel Of Fabric: The fabric is soft, not ultra-soft, but soft and comfortable. It wears and drapes well.

Wash-ability: The fabric is washable and can be washed easily. It should be washed inside-out, as should all garments. Because it is lace, it is best to wash this alone.

Closet-Space: This one takes up a slightly higher than average amount of hanging-space, because it is puffier in the skirt.

Folding: This dress should not be folded, as it will add creases that would require a bit more steaming than is good for you to do, over and over, to a dress and the fabric doesn't look, to me, like it could handle a great deal of interference.

Good luck finding the dress that will make you look and feel amazing.
